title: Mixed Berry Chia Yogurt Cups
steps: Stir the chia seeds, ground flaxseed, and cinnamon into the yogurt.
Hull and halve the strawberries; leave the other berries whole.
Divide the yogurt between four jars and top with all four berries.
Chill at least 2 hours, so the chia softens and thickens the yogurt.
storageNotes: Refrigerate up to 3 days, and eat the earliest days first — raspberries and blackberries soften fastest. The chia keeps absorbing liquid, so the cups thicken each day; loosen with a spoonful of milk or water if they get too stiff.
goldenRuleCallouts: Plain yogurt only — sweetened tubs are the added-sugar trap in a snack like this.
Built around the four berries already in the house this week, used early because they will not last to Saturday.
Berries, chia, and flax cover fiber and omega-3s without a packet of anything.
